Create a construction site centered on a tower crane and an active work area with scaffolding. Arrange stacked building materials near the work area and group portable site cabins along an accessible edge. Define the site with fences, using barriers to separate machinery and material storage from the clearer gaps between work zones. Position machinery near the scaffolding and material stacks, and concentrate debris around construction activity rather than distributing it uniformly. Keep the crane as the main vertical landmark and make the cabins, storage stacks, scaffolding, and machinery easy to distinguish within a coherent working site.
